patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Copy the Patch URL from below Run the game In the lower right corner of the title screen, there is a text entry field for Patch / MOD URL - paste the Patch URL into the box and click apply When “Completed” is displayed, exit the game and start it again Note: If the bar next to the "Apply" button doesn't move, the correct URL hasn't been entered
